articles.summary: ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC, listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange Market in April, 2014. (TWSE: 8150), is a leading independent provider of total semiconductor testing and packaging solutions to fabless companies, integrated device manufacturers (IDM) and foundries. We provide a full range of back-end testing services for high density memory, mixed-signal and liquid crystal display (LCD) driver semiconductors.
